The '''Avesta Plantation''' was the estate of the [[Avesta family]], the governing house of [[Makeb]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]], it was the base of operations of [[Shalim Avesta]], head of the Avesta family and its [[Avesta Mining Corporation|mining corporation]] and Makeb's ''de facto'' head of state. Shalim and his loyalist militia, aided by representatives from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], rallied the effort to bring down [[Supreme Mogul]] [[Toborro]] and evacuate the people of Makeb to safety.
